verdict.rationale: Clerk is described throughout as a hosted, managed SaaS service (drop-in components, hosted APIs, hosted MCP server, status page for its own hosted service) with no evidence of self-hosted/on-prem deployment, private-instance operation, or bring-your-own-database options. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions self-managed deployment or data residency control, and community comments focus on reliability/pricing rather than deployment control.
